title: A tag makes a target easier
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: Complement components can coat a microbe and enhance its recognition by phagocytes, a process called opsonization. Complement has other functions too.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: Some complement proteins coat a microbe. What can that coating help phagocytes do? Complement components can coat a microbe and enhance its recognition by phagocytes, a process called opsonization. Complement has other functions too.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: What is coating a microbe to improve phagocyte recognition called? Opsonization can help phagocytes recognize coated targets.

recall.question: What is coating a microbe to improve phagocyte recognition called?
recall.why: Opsonization can help phagocytes recognize coated targets.
